parsed.answer: No past ticket reports this exact problem, which is Caps Lock turning on every time Quick Accent is used while Backspace and Caps Lock are swapped in Keyboard Manager. PowerToys#45936 is a Quick Accent ticket about an intermittent Shift lock with no remap involved. PowerToys#9300 and the tickets closed as duplicates of it describe Caps Lock toggling despite a Keyboard Manager remap, but none involves Quick Accent. The archive offers no fix or confirmed workaround for your case. Please keep this ticket open and attach a PowerToys bug report ZIP (tray icon > Report Bug). Include the exact remap, which is Backspace to Caps Lock and Caps Lock to Backspace, and the Quick Accent activation key you use. The one workaround seen in the older Keyboard Manager tickets is to turn Keyboard Manager off, switch Caps Lock off, and turn it back on. That may clear the stuck state, but it does not stop it from recurring.
